mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines for 3 consecutive months is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases are not followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises & PAYEMS falls is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) combined with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals weakening demand and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases & UNRATE increases is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4% signals increased borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
